{{Quote|You're Mikhtor Doss, aren't you? I've read about you and your mercenaries. Or are you actually pirates? The reports are a bit vague.|Mara Jade|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
'''Mikhtor Doss's mercenaries''' were a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] led by [[Mikhtor Doss]]. About [[0 ABY/Legends|eight months]] after [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] they were involved in a plot to capture five rogue [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], known as the [[Hand of Judgment]], and put them out of commission. The plan was made by [[Bok Yost]], the [[Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] of [[Elegasso]]'s [[Skemp District]], and worked well before [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], got involved and rescued the stormtroopers, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Doss and several of his companions.<ref name="Choices of One" />
